title: Atlas 1.1 — Project Registry
description: Research programs and delivery repositories, distinct from Agent Registry (executable identities) and Person Registry (individuals). Does NOT duplicate atlas-state.json's 26 component/domain nodes — those remain the canonical internal research-domain graph (see PR #6's Dependency Graph). This registry covers what atlas-state.json doesn't: (a) delivery repositories this session directly verified, (b) project identifiers referenced by the founder or a third party that this session could not independently verify, tracked honestly rather than omitted or asserted.

kind.description: REPOSITORY = a real GitHub repository this session worked in directly. ATLAS_DOMAIN_REF = a pointer to an existing atlas-state.json node id, never a data duplicate. EXTERNAL_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED = a project name referenced externally (e.g. by the founder relaying another node) with no independently verifiable artifact yet.

status.description: SOURCE_NOT_INGESTED / NOT_VERIFIED_IN_THIS_SCOPE / WAITING_FOR_NEW_EVIDENCE do not assert non-existence, only that this session has no independently verifiable evidence yet

repo_url.description: required context for kind=REPOSITORY, null otherwise

atlas_domain_ref.description: must resolve to a real atlas-state.json node id when kind=ATLAS_DOMAIN_REF, null otherwise
